name: Firefly III
description: Personal finance manager for budgeting and account tracking.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      APP_KEY: {{env.APP_KEY}}
      DB_CONNECTION: mysql
      DB_HOST: {{serviceName}}-db
      DB_PORT: "3306"
      DB_DATABASE: firefly
      DB_USERNAME: firefly
      DB_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/upload:/var/www/html/storage/upload
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-db
  {{serviceName}}-db:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD: "yes"
      MYSQL_USER: firefly
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: firefly
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/db:/var/lib/mysql
